newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks extend gains on land liquidity plan.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks extend gains on land liquidity plan.

text.p: Japanese banks were mostly higher on Wednesday morning as the government's plan to announce measures to improve land liquidity continued to buoy the sector which is plagued by property-related bad loans, brokers said.

As of 0137 GMT, the sector was ranked second on the gainers list. The Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd added 50 yen to 1,340. Sanwa Bank Ltd gained 10 yen to 1,370. It was the fourth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with a turnover of 3.581 million. Sakura Bank Ltd was 10 yen higher at 763.
